title: Unit Event — Halt! Tenma's on the Case — Episode2 Hiori Jidaigeki Studio Park

meta.Event Outline: At Kijima's suggestion, Tsukasa has been putting on muscle to increase his acting chops. He and the others arrive at the Jidaigeki Studio Park with the Mikazukigumi troupe, but news of a theft puts the new production on hold...and that's when Tsukasa spots a suspicious ninja on the lot!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Alright!
Today is all about running!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(This is as fundamental as it gets!
Plus...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (The Heihachi I'm going to play for “Ginnosuke's on the Case!” is supposed to be an Edo-period detective famous for his agility.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (In other words, the more I run, run and run, the closer my body will become to that of my character! And my portrayal of him will improve just that much!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
So, there's only one thing to do!
*Roar*

rows.Speaker: Passerby
rows.Line:
Wh-Whoa!
Why's that person shouting while running...?!

rows.Speaker: Dog
rows.Line: Woof! Woof!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Next, stretches!
I'm all set to go after that nice, relaxing bath!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Regardless of what role I'm given, I won't be able to move properly if I'm not flexible enough. So, I'm going to become as bendy as an octopus...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Let's start with some straddle splits...!
Hnng! This still appears to be my limit...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But! I need to exceed my limits in order to advance to the next stage! Move forward, Tsukasa Tenma! Go above and beyond!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hey, Tsukasa!
You gotta keep your voice down or the neighbors are gonna start asking if we got a dog again.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Owwwwwww!
Sorry, Saki, I'm stuck! I think I overdid it! Please lend me a hand!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh no...!
Are you okay, Tsukasa?!
A few weeks later
Hiori Jidaigeki Studio Park

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Whoa!!! This is so cool!!!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Look at the shops and houses! It's just like in the movies! Oh, that one's selling dango!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So, this is the famed Hiori Jidaigeki Studio Park. What a wonderful place. All the buildings and structures look historically accurate.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah...!
It's like we've traveled back in time to the Edo period...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, look!
There's a bunch of ninjas over there! And a samurai!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Those are cast members, and I believe a few of the guests as well. Anyone who visits can rent costumes and become the character of their choice.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
A merchant, a tea shop girl, a samurai...
I'm seeing quite a wide variety. And there seem to be many families dressed up together, perhaps because it's a long holiday.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hehe. I like how that ninja over there is taking pictures with everyone instead of trying to be sneaky.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
What else do they have...?
A trick house, a ninja maze, horseback riding and a riverboat tour. They've really got everything here.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hehe!
Now I'm even more excited that we get to do a show here starting tomorrow... But...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You don't seem all that happy, Tsukasa...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I thought you'd start feeling a little better after we got here...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But this is worse than we thought.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Are you sure you're okay, Tsukasa?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, I'm fine...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We heard from Mr. Kijima that you were successful in becoming more fit and getting your body to resemble Heihachi's.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I thought you'd be happy instead of sad.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah!
I mean, just look at how big and cool your calves have gotten!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, that I'm happy about...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But I deeply regret not being able to figure out how to wall jump the way he would...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, I suppose you would still be bothered by that...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You started practicing how to wall jump while thinking about how to play him, right...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That's right...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: In “Ginnosuke's on the Case!”, Heihachi constantly has trouble keeping up with Chusuke the swift-footed thief.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Knowing Heihachi, I imagined he'd become so frustrated by how Chusuke keeps making a fool out of him that he'd decide to come up with a special technique for defeating his nemesis.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That led me to wall jumping, Chusuke's forte.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I figured that learning to do so would be the best way to capture the way Heihachi moves, regardless of whether or not I'd actually end up using it in our performances...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
But wall jumping is really hard, right?
I mean, you're basically trying to become a ninja.
Still, you were able to figure out how your character moves and behaves. For that, you should give yourself a pat on the back.
se_walk_men_003_1

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, Mr. Kijima...!

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: I understand why you're feeling the way you are. Not being able to move the way you want can be incredibly frustrating...

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: But that doesn't mean you're allowed to keep feeling bad about yourself.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line:
The show opens tomorrow!
So, let's turn that frown upside down!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: R-Right...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(He's right...
I don't have time to be feeling sorry for myself right now.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (We're working in collaboration with the Hiori Jidaigeki Studio Park on this production of “Ginnosuke's on the Case!”)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Not only that, these streets will be acting as our stage. Everyone here will be watching us, and it's an incredible opportunity for Mikazukigumi to get its name out there.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I want the members of this troupe to be rewarded for all their hard work. Just one more reason I have to help make this show a success!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Alright...!
I'm all set and ready to go now!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We're going to put on another successful show and send all the guests home smiling!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hehe. He's finally back to being his usual self.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: There's the Tsukasa we're used to seeing.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe♪ Then, let's psych ourselves up by doing our usual thing!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Let's have a nin-nin-wonderhoy time here at the Jidaigeki Studio Park!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa, Rui & Nene
rows.Line: Nin-nin-wonderhoy!
The next day

rows.Speaker: Heihachi
rows.Line:
“Mr. Ginnosuke!
Such beautiful weather we have today!”

rows.Speaker: Ginnosuke
rows.Line:
“Hello, Heihachi.
It is nice out, but won't your wife get mad if she finds out that you're wasting time like this?”

rows.Speaker: Heihachi
rows.Line:
“What are you talking about?!
I'm here helping our capable constable, the one and only Ginnosuke! There's no way she can get mad at me!”
se_run_women_003_1

rows.Speaker: Ohana the Tea Shop Girl
rows.Line:
“H-Help!
It's terrible, Mr. Ginnosuke!”

rows.Speaker: Heihachi
rows.Line: “It's the middle of the day. What's got you so worked up?”

rows.Speaker: Ohana the Tea Shop Girl
rows.Line: “That swift-footed thief, Chusuke, seems to have struck again! He stole a pot from the magistrate's mansion! It's apparently a very valuable family heirloom!”

rows.Speaker: Ginnosuke
rows.Line:
“What?!
Chusuke struck again...?!”

rows.Speaker: Heihachi
rows.Line: “Stop right there!!!”

rows.Speaker: Heihachi
rows.Line:
“Grr...!
Curse you, Chusuke, for being so quick...!”

rows.Speaker: Ginnosuke
rows.Line: “Hmm... Even you're struggling to catch him, Heihachi. We may need to come up with a new plan...”
se_walk_women_003_1

rows.Speaker: Hyakuhime the Roaming Princess
rows.Line:
“Hm?
What are you two doing there?”

rows.Speaker: Ginnosuke
rows.Line:
“Hm? You're not from around here...
But I recognize your face.”

rows.Speaker: Ginnosuke
rows.Line: “Aren't you that princess that everyone has been talking about? Hyakuhime? The one who's always roaming around the city...”

rows.Speaker: Hyakuhime the Roaming Princess
rows.Line:
“Oh, you know who I am?
So much for hoping to tease you two.”

rows.Speaker: Ginnosuke
rows.Line: “Actually, princess, may we ask you for your assistance? You'll get to help catch an interesting criminal...”

rows.Speaker: Hyakuhime the Roaming Princess
rows.Line:
“Oh, that sounds like fun!
In that case, I'll be more than willing to help!”

rows.Speaker: Heihachi
rows.Line: “So, your honor, you were behind it all!”

rows.Speaker: Ginnosuke
rows.Line: “You had Chusuke steal your pot in order to have your upstanding superior framed. And for quite some time now, you've been using these methods to get rid of anyone you see as a nuisance...!”

rows.Speaker: Magistrate
rows.Line:
“Grr...!
You know too much! Deal with them, Munechika!”

rows.Speaker: Munechika
rows.Line:
“Understood.
I, Munechika, shall not fail you.”

rows.Speaker: Munechika
rows.Line: “Prepare yourselves!”

rows.Speaker: Ginnosuke
rows.Line:
“Bring it on!
I feel like I can beat anyone right now!”

rows.Speaker: Chusuke
rows.Line:
“Grr...!
But I can't get caught! I'm THE Chusuke...”

rows.Speaker: Ginnosuke
rows.Line:
“Too bad for you, Chusuke.
Your legs were no match for me and Heihachi.”

rows.Speaker: Heihachi
rows.Line: “That's right! Mr. Ginnosuke figured out where you were going and I ran ahead to stop you. The next instant, we had you trapped like a rat!”

rows.Speaker: Ginnosuke
rows.Line: “Now, Chusuke, it's time for us to tie you up!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Phew...! We got an excellent response today!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
The crowd looked so happy!
I even heard some of the little kids cheering us on!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. I was a little worried initially since this was our first day performing somewhere completely new, but I'm glad things ended up going so well...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Me too. Let's keep up the good work and do our best again tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, let's!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (A part of me still isn't satisfied...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (The audience would've been even more thrilled if I'd learned how to wall jump. But my body just isn't able to keep up...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(No, stop!
There isn't any point in beating yourself up over this!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Right now, you need to focus on doing everything you can to put on the best performance! Such is the duty of a star!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Tsukasa? Hey, Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
He's making a bunch of weird faces again...
But I guess that's normal for him.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. But he won't be able to head over towards our lodging in this state. Why don't I get his attention? I'll clap my hands like this and...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wh-What was that?! Are we under attack?! Did Chusuke strike again?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
How long did you plan on spacing out?
We need to start making our way to where we're staying.
se_walk_women_003_1
se_walk_men_003_1

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Let's head over to the inn, Tsukasa!
I can't wait to see what food they serve us today♪
se_run_women_003_1

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
A-Alright!
Hey, wait for me!
se_run_men_003_1

rows.Speaker: Guests
rows.Line:
Wow...
That was such a great show.

rows.Speaker: Guests
rows.Line: What was it called? “Ginnosuke's on the Case!”...? We just stopped by to see what was going on, but those sword fights were so cool! Now I wanna see it again.

rows.Speaker: Guests
rows.Line:
Me too!
I might recommend coming here to my friends...

rows.Speaker: Guests
rows.Line:
Huh?
Where's my bag?! I left it right here...!

rows.Speaker: Guests
rows.Line:
Huh?! It's gone?!
Are you sure you didn't leave it somewhere else?

rows.Speaker: Guests
rows.Line:
N-No, I left it right here!
I know I did. I swear...

rows.Speaker: Guests
rows.Line: Then... What if someone stole it?

rows.Speaker: Guests
rows.Line:
Y-You might be right...!
Let's go tell the park staff!
